notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The **Weekdays** and **Weekend** tabs in the schedule now carry the same round count badge as the Settings tabs above them, instead of small dim text. Two counts in one drawer, saying the same kind of thing in one voice.
- The **updated to …** announcement in the readout blinks five times rather than four, so it is harder to miss on the one launch after an update where it is ever seen.
- Small wording fix in **Start when you sign in**.

## Bug fixes

- **The top bar could push its own buttons onto a second line.** A long station name in the schedule chip, or the Desktop-shortcut button appearing, was enough — and the items that did not fit were the last ones: the pin and the settings buttons.
- Worse than it sounds, because the panel then grew taller and the controls row went under the bottom of a window that is a fixed size and cannot be dragged.
- The row now stays one row, and the next-up station text is what gives way. It also gains an ellipsis: it used to stop mid-word with nothing to show it had been cut.
